metadata.description: Deterministic, backlog-driven autonomous execution loop for Claude Code

plugins.name: loop-virtuoso
plugins.description: Claude Code only. A backlog-driven delivery loop that feeds the agent one small item at a time and accepts it only when verify commands pass and a write-boundary guard approves. Also opt-in guard hooks, a settings hardener, a setup audit (doctor), setup evals against vanilla Claude Code, and starter templates. Ships hooks, scripts, commands, and 2 skills
